<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def hline(f):
    a = f.ascii.split('\n')
    # find the dashed row near player center
    best=None
    for i in range(64):
        row=a[i]
        cnt=sum(1 for j in range(64) if row[j] in 'wg')
        if cnt>5:
            cols=[j for j in range(64) if row[j] in 'wg']
            best=(i,min(cols),max(cols),cnt)
    return best
print('before LEFT:', hline(last_transition.before_frame))
res = action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT:', hline(current_frame))
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']>=10 and n['id']<50:
        print('player M', n['boundary'][:2])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
